text: minervini: "day_vol 1.22 modest (C6)." On my method modest is not a grade: C16 sets +40% over average as the floor, so day_vol 1.22 is a fail, not a softer buy. Your "close to the pivot" is half of C17; the other half is that the pivot was bought on volume. Coil warn also leaves the base unconfirmed (R3). What clears me: a new high on 1.4x volume, which would prove my objection early and move me to SUPPORT on leadership.
